Call us

All current or prospective students can call us.

Monday, Wednesday and Friday: 9am to 5pm (AEDT)
Tuesday and Thursday: 10am to 5pm (AEDT)

From within Australia

1800 793 864 (1800 SYD UNI)

From outside Australia

+61 2 8627 1444

Other reasons to contact us

In an emergency

  • Call triple zero (000) for fire, ambulance, or police
    • if your life is being threatened
    • if someone is seriously ill or injured
    • if you just witnessed a serious incident
    • then contact campus security (below).
       

For an urgent issue

  • Call +61 2 9351 3333 to reach campus security 24 hours a day.
     

With a non-urgent enquiry

  • Call +61 2 9351 3487 to reach campus security when the matter is not urgent.

Enquire about building access, maintenance, safety procedures, and more

  • Call 1300 226 787 (1300 CAMPUS)
  • Email campus.assist@sydney.edu.au
     

If you've lost or found something on campus

  • Visit the lost and found property page

If you have any questions about donating to the University, please contact our donor support team

Make a complaint or share feedback

For general media queries

  • Call +61 2 8627 0246
     

For faculty specific media and PR representatives

  • Visit the media contacts page
     

To find contact details for a specific expert

  • Search our expert database

Government, businesses, start-ups

For government, enterprise-level business or high-tech start-ups who want to be connected with our leading researchers and students. 

  • Email engage.team@sydney.edu.au
  • Complete the engagement enquiry form
     

Connect with us about research collaboration and international partnerships

  • Call +61 2 9351 6220
  • Email pvc.ge@sydney.edu.au

For general research enquiries

  • Call +61 2 8627 8111
  • Complete the research enquiry form

Submit HDR student enquiries anywhere you can submit a current student enquiry.  

To find out how to access your personal information, make a GIPA request, or serve a subpoena, warrant or court order, visit the accessing University information page.

If you are from an international university, research organisation or government body and are planning a visit, we'll do our best to develop a visiting schedule that will give you and our staff lots of opportunities to connect.

  • Complete our official visit request form
